description: In repos/human-surface-vessel/src/store.ts, the header comment states "No persistence — a restart clears every store." Add a startup hydration function that reads the durable JSONL log at WORKSPACE_ROOT/interactor-log/uiFeedback_write.jsonl and seeds the in-memory feedback array with those records, so recentFeedback() returns the human complaints that already exist on disk instead of an empty list after every restart.
goal_text: In repos/human-surface-vessel/src/store.ts, the header comment states "No persistence — a restart clears every store." Add a startup hydration function that reads the durable JSONL log at WORKSPACE_ROOT/interactor-log/uiFeedback_write.jsonl and seeds the in-memory feedback array with those records, so recentFeedback() returns the human complaints that already exist on disk instead of an empty list after every restart.
